StPageFlip 2.0.7 (MIT), upstream https://github.com/Nodlik/StPageFlip
Browser UMD distributable: package/dist/js/page-flip.browser.js from the
published npm package page-flip@2.0.7 (https://www.npmjs.com/package/page-flip).
The published archive is fetched by the explicit `deploy.sh vendor` step,
without executing package lifecycle scripts. Installed under this directory.
Do not fetch it from a CDN at runtime. Keep the upstream LICENSE alongside.
Upgrade by reviewing and pinning the intended version, testing on DEV, and
recording the new SHA256; do not switch to a floating @latest dependency.
